page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Marginal notes in the right margin. Signature and catchword below the last line.

main_text.p: totidem. In pactis præcipua fuêre: ut libertas, patria, & jus cuique suum, ditiones, juridisdictiones, illæsæ conservarentur: in exilium sine causa justa nemo pelleretur: judiciis & legibus controversiæ disceptarentur & finirentur: vis omnis abesset: exteri principes aliique libertatem præsturi, aut injurij cuiquam futuri mutuâ ope finibus regionis arcerentur; ad hanc rem non ferenti opem gravis multa esset: multa æqualiter inter socios dividere-tur: si qua pars agri hujus socii, si quis vicus, si vir nobilis ignobilisve, in fraudem civitatis aut agri præsidium haberet, peregrinumve militem intra fines vocaret, ei iisvè conjunctis omnium viribus resisteretur. Deinde de maleficiis & injuriis coërcendis prolixè, de obsidibus expeditionum tempore in urbe habendis.cc NOTA. Tum porrò hæc: à sententiis judicum agrariorum provocatio esset ad tribunal urbanum intra tempus legitimum, æque sententiæ à conventu juridico sociorum omnium in urbe recognoscerentur: conventus juridici quatuor pluresve in urbe quotannis haberentur: violans eumtem ad urbem mercatus causa, aut inde redeunte triplæ pœnæ reus esset: tributum à sociis agrariis non exigeretur,

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right: "NOTA." beside the line "habendis. Tum porrò", then "cc" beside the lines "dicum", "nal" and "sententiæ". The printed "cc" marks are ditto marks for NOTA, and their exact positions in the sentence are approximate. The first word "totidem." runs on from the previous page. The running head is printed without the page number. Catchword "nisi" at lower right. Signature "G 3" at lower left (printed "G ʒ"). Italic is used for the passages from "ut libertas" to "resisteretur." and from "à sententiis" to "exigeretur,"; the scan is slightly blurred here, so the boundaries of italic are uncertain.
